about: The studio's narrator voices. Each has a short recorded sample in the app (voices/samples/, made with the open Kokoro-82M speech model and checked by a speech recogniser) to hear it before choosing. In a film the voice is made when the film is made — offline by the phone's own speech engine (Android TextToSpeech) at the pitch and pace under 'phone', or online by the neural voice under 'natural'. A recorded narrator can always be chosen instead from the user's own voice library.
licence: Voice definitions: part of KahaniFilm. The sample recordings were synthesised for KahaniFilm with Kokoro-82M (hexgrad, Apache License 2.0, https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0) through sherpa-onnx; they contain no third-party recording. Film speech is produced by the phone's speech engine or the online neural voice service.
